## Task request — Vellistry 44-item checklist items #02, #11–15, #18, #20–26 (governance only)

**Dependency:** [remediation index #71](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/issues/71). **Role:** Codex is the *only* assigned implementer, ChatGPT = coordinator/evidence reviewer, owner = final approver and merger. This issue is a Codex handoff **request**, not proof Codex has started.

### Why now / verified source state

- Owner-selected Codex-primary ADR is [draft PR #66](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/pull/66), authored previously by ChatGPT; PR66 remains **unmerged**, head `36da413fea67179ac8395af1cececd477fd193a2`. Its existing seven changed files include AGENTS.md, implementation operating model, ADR0008, history, planning and current state.
- New integrated CI from [PR #70](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/pull/70) has **merged** to main `a8751190073f682caabdc2897d8f64bc59ac9ebb`; the ready CI succeeded. Verify any later main drift before working.
- Effective merged-main AGENTS.md still says Stage3 is a v0.1 proposal, and merged CURRENT-STATE.md still calls PR70 unmerged. This is stale-source truth, not merely stylistic cleanup.
- PR #65/#68 remain distinct draft implementation branches; don't import them.

### Bounded objective

Make the **effective** Git-first Codex-primary agent contract and current project entrypoint coherent with owner-approved decisions and the merged CI reality, preserving accepted historical provenance.

**Implementer:** Codex prepares a **new isolated task/worktree/branch from current merged main**. Avoid direct implementation by ChatGPT or silent takeover/force-push of the ChatGPT-authored PR66 branch. Retain provenance for any applied PR66 source (e.g. reviewed `-x` cherry-picks when feasible, or explicit per-file sourcing). Open a **new draft PR referencing #66** for owner to choose, or obtain express owner authorization before modifying PR66's branch. Do not merge or close PR66 unilaterally.

**Provisional unused IDs:** `VEL-TASK-0008`/`VEL-CP-0008`/`VEL-EB-0008`; verify against current refs before selection. Commit task + selected governing source snapshots, **generate and validate immutable pinned pack before content edits**, then code/docs changes, real tests and structured bundle.

### In scope (minimize duplication)

- Reconcile `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, `PROJECT.md`, `SOURCE-OF-TRUTH.md`, `CURRENT-STATE.md`, `docs/agent-workflow/IMPLEMENTATION-OPERATING-MODEL.md`, ADR0008, ADR index and relevant owner history **where necessary**, without rewriting accepted source or inventing new owner approvals.
- Keep accepted Codex role exact: owner decides; ChatGPT coordinates/reviews; Codex implements; Git canonical; optional alternate agent only with explicit task exception. Define lightweight-governance exceptions separately from qualifying implementation.
- Provide one lightweight onboarding **current facts** entrypoint and links to historical detailed records: merged main SHA as checked, active PR/issue list, CI ready/main status, active holds (PR68 SQL privilege migration unapproved, direct signed-out JWT risk, dev Supabase acceptance NOT_RUN), and source authority levels. Preserve dated archive; do not copy entire histories into CURRENT-STATE.
- Reconcile G_DESIGN/G_CODE/task exceptions/G_PRIVATE_PILOT/G_RELEASE; don't convert bounded owner coding approval into blanket release/private-manuscript approval.
- Preserve existing ContextPack schema, report FACT/INTERPRETATION/PROPOSAL and ensure no unrelated app/auth/SQL/CI routing changes.

### Mandatory negative/acceptance cases

1. Clean agent can locate active main SHA, accepted owner role, active tasks and security holds without reading historical chat.
2. PR70 merged fact is reflected correctly; old draft/PR64-era claims remain only dated/history-labeled, not active current facts.
3. Future tasks cannot interpret a coordinator's write access as coding approval or choose new executor without explicit owner exception.
4. No accepted ADR is silently modified/rejected; ADR0008 owner-selected authorization trace is preserved and distinct from actual merge.
5. CI merged on main still validates changed metadata/handoff docs; exact-head tests execute, not pre-step failures.
6. No cloud Supabase, new privilege migration, secrets, paid calls, real manuscripts, merge or owner account settings.

### Completion evidence

- Coverage/delta map from current main to PR66 and each selected entrypoint before edits
- Canonical Task → immutable pinned ContextPack → ExecutionBundle with full SHAs, commands, tests, status, source gaps
- A separate **draft PR** preserving provenance of PR66 contents and linking this issue; owner disposition proposed, not preempted
- ChatGPT source/CI review, then **owner-only** decision regarding adoption/merging and eventual closure/supersession of PR66

**Status at creation:** requested and **NOT_DISPATCHED to Codex**. Opening an issue is not a Codex runtime invocation.
title: VEL-GOV-002 — Codex reconcile PR66 and effective main governance after CI merge
